goldens.comment: The code uses Error log level for what appears to be debugging information. This will pollute error logs in production. Consider using Debug or Info level instead.
goldens.reasoning: C1 flags the Error log level being used for non-error output, which is the same issue.

goldens.comment: The cleanup job ticker was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, which can lead to increased database load and contention due to more frequent execution of cleanup tasks. This change should be reviewed to ensure it aligns with performance expectations.
goldens.reasoning: C2 points out the same ticker change from 10 minutes to 1 minute.

candidates: Annotation cleanup logs at Error level unconditionally even when err is nil, which will spam error logs and mask real production errors in all three cleanup paths (by time, by count, orphan tags)

Cleanup service ticker interval was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute, which appears to be a debugging artifact not mentioned in PR description, and conflicts with the 9-minute timeout designed for the 10-minute cycle
Cleanup logs include full ID lists which creates very large log lines and log bloat

In TestIntegrationAnnotationCleanUp, the per-subtest DB cleanup is registered after data creation and assertions, so any failure before registration leaves the shared DB dirty and can cascade-fail subsequent subtests
